d: The great cats are a group of apex predators that rest firmly at the top of the food chain. Lions, leopards and tigers all live uniquely with particular hunting prowess, advantages and pack hierarchy or solitary territories.
Explore the worlds of hooved animals from deer and rhinos to pigs and goats. A diverse collection of some of the most interesting animals in the world.
All fish have moveable jaws and are covered in scales, using gills to breath underwater. Many forming schools or shoals based on social structure, it's a unique group arrangement with many benefits.

Invertebrates include all forms of insects, spiders, scorpions, centipedes and crustations, with nearly 10 million species. In this episode we take a closer look at the survival structure of bees, ants and spiders.
Our closest relatives, primates are a diverse group of highly intelligent mammals. Over 440 species, with varied social structures and behaviours, explore chimpanzee's, gorillas, orangutan and more.
From the deserts to the densest jungles, one group of mammals can be found unlike all the rest. A few predatory but many carnivorous, marsupials include the red kangaroo to the tiny mouse.
Rodents exist everywhere on earth making up over 40% of all mammal species. This episode takes a look at the muroid family of rodents as well as beavers and squirrels.
A diverse group of distantly related families and species sharing a few common traits, marine invertebrates include polyps, octopus and jellyfish.
Teddy Bear, a Samoyed from Maine, gets a prosthetic for a missing rear paw and Lola Gray learns how to swim again after getting a brace.
As the troop expands and the economy plunges, scarce offerings at the temple leave the macaques competing with each other for sustenance.
The Galta Gang splits into two troops, with Bipin, Yash and Tito leading the splinter group into the city - and into the traps of the monkey catcher.
Rani and the temple troop rely on handouts, while Bipin and the exiles search for a new base. As prospects dim, they suddenly find a ray of hope.
